## Welcome

Today, you will create the workflow that produces the product.

Instead of plugging agents into an existing workflow, you will design a new workflow around how people and agents work together. You will give agents reusable context, add specialized capabilities, coordinate their work, and decide where human direction belongs.

By the end of this exercise, you will have a reusable agent workflow that can take on a product task and prepare a result for human review.

## Step 1: Open your workspace

1. Download and open the [GitHub Copilot app](https://github.com/features/ai/github-app).
2. Sign in to GitHub.
3. Add this repository as a project.
4. Start a new agent session for the repository.
5. Return to this issue and comment:

   ```text
   ready
   ```

> [!NOTE]
> Keep the GitHub Copilot app open. You will use it to build the context library in the next step.
